'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Greg Hodur LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Greg Hodur]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name on sheet: Tacos for Everybody!

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
